basis: Static source audit plus user visual verification that Bank works and Control legacy Diagnostics card is gone.
user_verified_observations: Bank works again under Bank Owner dependency bridge.
Control Room legacy diagnostics blocks were removed after source-level patches.
Plain Diagnostics card is gone after disabling pmp-owner-diagnostics-host-v1 visible host.

bank_owner_owns_bank_shell_home_list.evidence: make(d) creates #bank, data-bank-home, data-bank-buttons, and data-bank-detail-wrap; tab(d) adds Bank bottom tab; paint/open functions remain native Bank owner path.
bank_owner_owns_bank_shell_home_list.note: The Bank owner still uses same-frame API lookups internally; pmp-bank-owner-dependency-bridge-v1 exposes dependencies across frames without owning UI.

bank_owner_dependency_boundary.evidence: Bridge exposes existing Bank APIs across same-origin parent/iframe windows and calls Bank owner scan; it does not repaint Bank, create Bank DOM, intercept buttons, rebuild Bank, or write IndexedDB/storage.
bank_owner_dependency_boundary.classification: dependency bridge only, not UI owner

continuous_run_owner_scope.evidence: Owner detects Continuous Run detail context and inserts data-bank-screen-owner-v1 under data-run-bank-tools; removeWrong removes stray screen-owner content outside the intended host.
continuous_run_owner_scope.limitation: Full Continuous Run detail visual path still needs a dedicated run-state/open-detail check before final Pass 9 certification.

control_room_owns_control_tools_only.evidence: Legacy Control diagnostics sources are receipt/API-only and should not render visible diagnostic blocks/buttons/cards in Control Room. User verified the plain Diagnostics card is gone.

diagnostics_tab_owns_visible_diagnostics.evidence: Diagnostics Owner owns Diagnostics screen content; bottom tab forcer owns Diagnostics bottom tab active state. Legacy sources now defer visible diagnostics to modern Diagnostics tab.

helpers_do_not_repaint_or_compete.evidence: Known helper approaches that caused flicker, interception, broad hiding, or wrong-surface ownership are disabled or rejected.

no_legacy_diagnostics_host_active_in_con.evidence: Visible host creation is disabled at source. User reported: 'Okay it’s gone'.

non_blocking_open_items.item: Run a final visual no-regression window after refresh/navigation.
non_blocking_open_items.reason: Certification should wait until user confirms Bank, Control, and Diagnostics remain stable after normal tab switching.

non_blocking_open_items.item: Open Continuous Run Bank detail and run the Bank / Continuous Run Visual State diagnostic if needed.
non_blocking_open_items.reason: Current audit passes ownership boundaries but has not freshly observed Continuous Run detail content visible in the current stable runtime.

certification_decision.why_not_certified_yet: Needs final no-regression visual confirmation from the stable runtime after refresh/tab-switching, especially Bank, Control, Diagnostics, and optionally Continuous Run detail.
certification_decision.next_step: Ask user to refresh and do final visual confirmation. If stable, create Pass 9 certification receipt.
